principle_statements: This sample contract is a fixture; replace it with the real framework phase document for production audits.
The report must distinguish observed data, inferred interpretation, uncertainty, and validation status.
forbidden_output_families: The report must not present unsupported interpretations as verified fact.
The report must not suppress material uncertainty in executive-facing findings.
certainty_constraints: Strong claims require visible uncertainty treatment and traceable support.
Absolute language is prohibited unless the upstream evidence explicitly authorizes it.
evidence_traceability_expectations: Every high-stakes claim must cite a source, table, or upstream support signal.

rules.text: Examples are illustrative and do not create additional law.
